descriptions.100m-to-say-i-do: Her wedding to Kieran for a $ 100 million inheritance is shaken when her first love, Luke, returns. With betrayal and secrets around, she must choose between family duty and the man she once loved.
descriptions.a-queen-for-the-mafia-kings: A forgotten past, three powerful brothers, and a woman caught in the middle. As loyalties shift and secrets emerge, Jasmine must decide who deserves her trust—and who only wants her power.
descriptions.addicted-to-his-darkness: After escaping her abusive husband, Meryl, a trauma survivor, is drawn to her dominant boss, Daniel. She reclaims her love life and learns the difference between abuse and consensual submission. But her ex is determined to reclaim his property and destroy her new life.
descriptions.after-all-that-hurt: Amanda is a successful psychologist stuck in a cold, loveless marriage — until a handsome younger man from her past saves her on the street and turns her world upside down. As their passionate connection grows, dark secrets, dangerous games, and shocking betrayals begin to surface.
descriptions.all-in-double-or-die: A woman is forced to cheat in a high-stakes, secret poker tournament to save her fiancé's life. As she navigates a web of lies involving terrorists and government spies, she must decide who to trust before the final cards are shown.
descriptions.alphas-love-captive: A young woman is captured by a powerful werewolf leader after she kills a member of his pack to protect her family. Forced to work at his estate, she discovers her secret heritage—changing everything.
descriptions.author-of-my-heart: On a late-night train, Lena is saved from assault by a famous novelist. What starts as a chance meeting turns into a fast, intense romance. But he hides secrets, tells lies, and his past refuses to stay buried.
descriptions.between-ice-and-fire: A mafia prince returns from exile, driven by a dark thirst for revenge against his older brother, and his first move is to kidnap the woman promised to him. Trapped in a dangerous game, the honorable heiress fights her growing desire for the captor who is also her enemy.
descriptions.billionaire-blackmail: Trapped in her boss’s luxurious estate, Samantha uncovers a deadly conspiracy that ties her family’s fate to his empire. Love was never part of the plan — until it’s too late to walk away.
descriptions.bloodlust: A bride on the run. A vampire boss with secrets. A blood contract that changes everything. Mira’s fight for freedom becomes tangled with Cassandra’s hunger, power, and forbidden desire.
descriptions.bound-by-his-kitchen: A secret FBI mission brings Mia into a famous restaurant where the food is perfect, the staff is dangerous, and the chef is impossible to ignore. To solve the case, she must survive Oliver’s challenges, Nora’s jealousy, and her own forbidden desire.
descriptions.bound-by-obsession: A confident real estate agent hides a secret life as a dominatrix—until one of her clients turns up dead. Now, a killer is watching her every move, and to survive, she must outplay a man who knows all her darkest secrets.
descriptions.brace-face-betty: Betty and Marcus hate each other from the moment they meet. She is the bullied new girl, he is the campus bad boy. But a forced school project reveals secrets, pressure, and feelings neither of them expected.
descriptions.brave-doll: Riley loses her home after crossing a powerful rich family, but a chance encounter brings her into their mansion. As she fights to protect the children she loves, she hides behind an alter ego and turns Leo’s cruel control into a dangerous game of desire and secrets.
descriptions.break-me-princess: Lily is poor, quiet, and alone. Aurora is noble, cruel, and untouchable. Their worlds collide in a taboo relationship built on secrets and control.
descriptions.breaking-the-professors-rule: Lisa, a struggling law student, fights for her sister’s future. To win custody of Annie, she must face family abuse, criminal power, and the cruelty of the underground world. But when cold Professor Brian Wood becomes her protector, his past and rules make love more risky than she is ready for.
descriptions.bride-for-quarterback: A humble janitor, desperate to save her sick son, agrees to a fake engagement with the NFL's most arrogant, scandal-ridden star quarterback to rebuild his image. As their public charade is tested by jealous rivals and dark secrets, their undeniable passion ignites, turning a simple business deal into a dangerous game.
descriptions.call-me-gianni-babygirl: A desperate young woman falls for her father's best friend, a dangerous billionaire who pulls her into his world. Caught between fear and desire, she risks everything for a forbidden love she cannot escape.
descriptions.chained-by-her-love: Leslie needs money to save her mother. She gets a job as an assistant to a powerful lingerie CEO — a woman with strict rules and secret desires. Trapped between fear and fascination, Leslie enters a world of seduction, control, and forbidden love.
descriptions.chosen-luna: Rejected by her own family, Luna-to-be Ayla flees into enemy territory where the ruthless Alpha, Draven, is her fated mate. Caught in his pack's dark world, she must fight a conspiracy to survive without the wolf she can't shift into.
descriptions.claimed-by-the-crown: April is a waitress who agrees to a contract marriage with Prince Christopher to escape her abusive stepfather. She moves to a grand palace and must face dangerous enemies while learning to live as a princess.
descriptions.confession: A devoted priest meets a woman from his past, awakening a dangerous desire. Torn between duty and love, he must choose—faith or passion? But secrets can destroy everything. Will he resist… or fall?
descriptions.cursed-temptation: After years of feeling invisible, Laura is drawn into a seductive realm ruled by Damian, a demon who awakens her hidden fire. But in his world, pleasure is never free, and every step toward power pulls her closer to a terrifying choice.
descriptions.designed-for-desire: When struggling artist Cecilia Brooks takes a job at a powerful architect’s studio, she quickly realizes it’s not just about design—it’s about control. Now she’s trapped in a mansion with a billionaire who never plays fair.
descriptions.escape-from-mile-marker-zero: After escaping her abusive boyfriend, Portia is saved by a stranger who takes her to a remote lake house. But when she discovers his dark past, she realizes she may have traded one danger for another.
descriptions.falling-for-tarzan: A spoiled city girl gets dumped in the wild by her rich boyfriend—only to be rescued by a mysterious forest man who’s never known modern life.
descriptions.falling-for-the-wrong-bride: To save her sick mother, waitress Sky agrees to a 3-month fake marriage with cold billionaire Grayson, who needs to secure his inheritance. Trapped in a hostile family, she uncovers a dangerous plot of manipulation and secrets orchestrated by his mother and rival half-brother.
descriptions.fated-to-be-the-alphas-mate: Chloe hides her pain and works in silence to save her family. When her wolf awakens, she learns she was never just a servant—but the Alpha’s true mate.
descriptions.first-tender-spark: Helena lands her dream job — but to get it, she must work for Eric, a spoiled heir with dark secrets. Caught between ambition, obsession, and danger, can she survive the world of fashion?
descriptions.forbidden-eyes-in-the-dark: Clarissa wanted one chance to become a star. Instead, she inherits her grandmother’s mansion, a threatening family secret, and a masked protector who knows too much. As old Hollywood’s darkest powers close in, desire becomes as dangerous as fear.
descriptions.forbidden-touch-my-vampire-ceo: Amanda is stuck in a toxic marriage until she discovers her boss is a vampire. He can’t touch her without pain, but when he saves her from her cruel husband, dangerous feelings spark between them.
descriptions.heart-of-the-yakuza: A waitress goes undercover in a Yakuza nightclub to clear her name, but a dangerous attraction to the powerful manager threatens to expose her mission. Caught between her duty to the police and her feelings for the man who murdered her father, Sofia must choose her loyalties before it's too late.
descriptions.heart-of-the-yakuza-2: Sofia and Jun must hide their love to stay safe from the dangerous criminal group. After helping the police arrest Jun's violent brother, Jun leaves his life of crime so he and Sofia can start a new life together. Can they truly escape their dark past, or will the shadows of the Yakuza follow them forever?
descriptions.her-heart-held-hostage: Caught between a dangerous woman and a manipulative ex, Eliza must choose who to trust. But in a world full of beautiful lies, her heart may betray her first.
descriptions.hidden-detective-falls-for-criminal: A young detective pretends to be a masseuse to spy on a rich and dangerous man who may hold the key to saving her brother. But the closer she gets, the harder it becomes to tell if he’s the enemy—or someone she can fall in love with.
descriptions.hiding-in-his-shower: A runaway rich girl hides in a stranger’s shower and accidentally crashes into the life of a dangerous, silent boy fresh out of prison. Their worlds collide fast — with secrets, enemies, and a forbidden love neither of them is ready for.
descriptions.highstakes-heartthrob: A sweet but desperate woman goes undercover for the FBI inside a dangerous mafia world, only to fall for the man she’s meant to betray. As she plays a deadly game of lies and desire with a charming killer, every touch could cost her life.
descriptions.hired-to-obey: Desperate for money, Emma takes a job with David Watkins—a powerful photographer with strict rules. Their chemistry is electric, but his world is dangerous: a vengeful ex, a deadly debt, and a contract that binds her in ways she never imagined. Can she escape, or is she already his?
descriptions.his-charming-maid-is-a-secret-killer: After escaping a killer organization, Anna hides as a maid inside a powerful mafia family. Her revenge plan starts to fall apart when she falls for the one man she was never meant to love.
descriptions.his-dark-kiss: Alice's life is turned upside down when she catches her boyfriend cheating and then discovers a gorgeous vampire, Byron, who claims they are soul-bonded. Now, she must quickly choose to accept a dangerous, eternal life with the vampire she's falling for in order to save them both.
descriptions.his-fake-bride-was-a-homeless-girl: Homeless Daisy D’Arcy stumbles into billionaire Adrian Beckett’s life right after his public, humiliating rejection. On impulse, he gives her the engagement ring meant for someone else—pulling her into a whirlwind makeover, fake romance, and real feelings.
descriptions.his-next-target-my-heart: James never misses a target, until Monica breaks his control. To save her from a deadly marriage, he risks his mission, his life, and the cold heart he thought was dead.
descriptions.i-died-and-woke-up-as-a-tv-show-villain: An actress dies on set and wakes up in the body of the villain she used to play — Tess Hart, the scandalous wife of a dangerous duke. Now trapped in a deadly romance, she must survive a world where love can kill and her.
descriptions.i-hate-how-much-i-want-you: Insecure Alicia loves her toxic childhood friend, CEO Reese, who rejects her. Years later, she returns as his cleaner to save her son, uncovering his fiancée's deadly plot. Betrayal and undeniable passion force them into a high-stakes, two-month bet to prove their love.
descriptions.i-kiss-my-exs-son: After a cruel betrayal by her rich lover, Meg finds comfort in the arms of a charming young man — only to discover he’s her ex’s son. What begins as revenge soon turns into forbidden love that could destroy them all.
descriptions.i-kissed-a-star-and-i-liked-it: With blackmail, a jealous ex, a controlling manager, and a cult hunting him down, his new life in Hollywood is anything but safe.
descriptions.i-married-him-to-escape-my-ex: Lana thinks she married an ordinary man for safety. She never expected him to be the one who could save her—and change her life forever.
descriptions.im-not-allowed-to-love-you: Pregnant and broke after her husband’s sudden death, Julia is taken in by his powerful family. But when his suspicious brother becomes her protector, grief turns into a dangerous, forbidden attraction.
descriptions.kiss-of-the-pirate-king: When a young noblewoman set to marry a vicious military commander sacrifices her freedom to a pirate captain in order to save her father, she has no idea what danger and romance await her at sea.
descriptions.love-in-the-ruck: Rugby made them enemies. Passion made them reckless. Now two teammates must survive jealousy, family pressure, and a love that refuses to stay hidden.
descriptions.love-lies-and-a-dead-tycoon: When Sable’s secret romance with a billionaire heir is exposed, she’s dragged into a deadly night of betrayal where the CEO is murdered and every clue points to her. With the mansion locked down, she must unravel the truth before the real killer strikes again.
descriptions.love-score: Daphne, a poor but talented tennis player, fights for her future at a rich university but quickly makes a powerful enemy in spoiled star Jackson. Their hateful clashes quickly turn into a forbidden romance, but a dangerous bet could cost Daphne everything.
descriptions.maca-the-snacker: Mocked for not fitting elite beauty standards, scholarship student Macarena becomes the enemy of arrogant campus star Emiliano. But when they must perform together, hate slowly turns into something neither expected.
descriptions.maid-to-love-him: Julia, a cleaning lady who was sent back to Mexico, hates the spoiled musician Andy Rubio, a guest at her hotel. Andy pretends to be "Santi," a simple maintenance worker, and Julia falls for him, not knowing his real identity. Their secret love forces Andy to choose between being a star and being his true self.
descriptions.make-me-yours: Amy, a poor cleaner, suddenly becomes the assistant of Lewis Mason, a rich and dominant CEO. He saves her sick mother but pulls Amy into his dark world of control, secrets, and dangerous love.
descriptions.married-against-the-will: Trapped in a sudden marriage to the cold and powerful Bobby Plainview, Ava's life becomes a high-stakes deal to save her family. She quickly learns that beneath his cruel control lies a dangerous desire, and the line between her duty and her growing passion for her captor is razor-thin.
descriptions.married-for-revenge: After her foster parents die on her birthday, Karli enters a contract marriage with a powerful heir to uncover the truth. But what begins as a plan for revenge turns into love at first sight.
descriptions.mission-to-love-the-enemy: She is a spy. He is the ruthless commander of the enemy nation. To save her people, Reese must deceive, seduce, and betray. But as she gets closer to Frank Henderson, the man she swore to hate, she finds herself trapped in a dangerous game—one where her heart becomes the ultimate weapon. Will she complete her mission, or will love ruin them both?
descriptions.mute-girl-loved-the-man-sent-to-betray-h: A mute woman runs from her violent husband and hides in a stranger’s house. As danger closes in, an unexpected bond forms between her and the man who tries not to care.
descriptions.my-billionaire-boss-claimed-me-as-his-pr: Ivy needs a job to get her niece back. Zach, her cold and arrogant boss, wants to break her. But the more they fight, the harder they fall.
descriptions.my-billionaires-eyes-on-me: A struggling writer meets a powerful billionaire who becomes obsessed with her. As he secretly stalks and manipulates her life, danger grows around her. Drawn to his dark side, she must choose between fear and a desire she can't resist.
descriptions.my-dark-lord: When June and her abusive husband travel to midsummer festival, she discovers forbidden desire, dark rituals, and a village ruled by demons. Torn between survival and passion for the mysterious Janis, June must decide: escape, surrender… or become the sacrifice that could change everything.
descriptions.my-evil-sisters-fianc-is-my-mate: When shy and mistreated Emily accidentally ruins her sister's engagement party, she discovers a shocking secret — her sister’s fiancé is her fated mate. Now bound by a supernatural thread, Emily and the powerful alpha Drake must fight their growing desire and the wrath of her evil family.
descriptions.my-golden-cage: A job interview turns into a deadly trap. With her sister's life at stake, Katherine is forced into a surrogate pregnancy contract. Trapped in a mansion of secrets, she must escape before it's too late—or become their next victim.
descriptions.my-new-boss-is-my-dead-exboyfriend: Amelia’s world falls apart when Ryan, the man she loved and thought was dead, suddenly comes back. His return brings back strong feelings and dangerous secrets that could ruin her life.
descriptions.my-only-secret-desire: She's the daughter of a crime boss and his rival's target. He's her cold bodyguard, sworn to protect his mission. Their intense, forbidden love forces a deadly choice between duty and their own survival.
descriptions.my-perfect-stranger: A cheating ex broke Molly’s heart. A half-drowned stranger ruined her peace. Now he is pretending to be her boyfriend, charming her parents, and making her wonder if fake love can become real.
descriptions.obsessed-with-you: A lonely dancer and a broken cop find each other in a world of lies and danger. What begins as a rescue turns into a forbidden obsession.
descriptions.one-face-two-loves: A newlywed with amnesia and a new face is trapped by a doctor who convinces her she is his dead wife. As her real husband desperately searches for her, she must uncover which of the two men is the true monster before she loses her life again.
descriptions.overdrive-to-my-heart: Christopher survives impossible speed, pressure, and Formula 1 danger. But Sophie’s return after ten years pulls him back into obsession, betrayal, unfinished love, and painful secrets.
descriptions.playback: A young songwriter from a funeral home sneaks into the world of a fading pop star and helps him rediscover his true voice, while hiding her own secret superstar identity. Together, they turn heartbreak, jealousy, and fear into unforgettable songs, proving that raw feelings can become powerful music that changes both their lives.
descriptions.playing-her-dirty: Forced to spy on mob boss Isa Caruso, Sofia enters a world of luxury, danger, and dirty poker. But the deeper she plays, the harder it becomes to tell if she is bluffing Isa — or herself.
descriptions.pregnant-cinderella: A wealthy heir saves a pregnant woman with no home. To protect her baby and prove himself to his strict father, he pretends she is his wife. What starts as a deal soon turns into something more.
descriptions.pretend-you-love-me: Zoe is a quiet outsider, humiliated by everyone and broken in public. When her life falls apart, Chase appears — a dangerous biker with a dark past. He offers a fake relationship for protection and revenge.
descriptions.private-lessons-with-the-ballet-master: From cleaning floors to dancing under the spotlight, Sophie has one month to prove she belongs. But cruel rivals and a strict master turn her dream into an impossible test.
descriptions.queen-of-hearts: Andrea, a poor but strong student, enters an elite academy where status is decided by a deck of cards. The cruel King of Hearts, Nathaniel Sinclair, rules the game. By accident, Andrea becomes the new Queen of Hearts. Now she is trapped in a world of dangerous secrets, and a growing attraction to the boy who could destroy her.
descriptions.reality-show-love-or-dare-season-1: 24 y.o blogger Anastasia and 46 y.o financial director Ricardo try to prove that love can survive a major age gap. But jealousy and money push them to the edge. Can a carefree dreamer and a strict perfectionist find balance—or will their differences destroy their relationship?
descriptions.reality-show-love-or-dare-season-2: Harry and Jemima face tough love tests in the wild. She can’t stand other women looking at him, and he’s not sure she’s ready for real family life. Will their love survive the challenges—or fall apart under pressure?
descriptions.romancing-the-star: A production assistant, Nina Clark, must pretend to be the girlfriend of a famous bad-boy movie star Jack Thatch to fix his public image. The fake romance gets complicated by real feelings and threats from his jealous manager.
descriptions.scarlet-seduction: Sabrina enters a new academy and immediately clashes with Valentin, the ruthless boy who rules it like a king. Their war of wills soon turns into dangerous attraction—until dark and mysterious secrets throw her into a deadly battle where love and power are the sharpest weapons.
descriptions.secret-affair-with-my-billionaire-boss: New intern Sienna Winston meets CEO Jasper Wallace while trying to rebuild her life, and the spark between them is impossible to ignore. But jealous rivals, office drama, and painful misunderstandings threaten to tear them apart.
descriptions.secret-romance-with-bfs-dad: A poor but proud girl is betrayed by her rich boyfriend — and finds unexpected love and protection in the arms of his father. What starts as heartbreak turns into a forbidden romance between two souls who shouldn’t fall for each other… but can’t resist.
descriptions.secret-society-till-blood-do-us-part: At an elite boarding school, a scholarship girl is pulled into a secret society where power comes at a cost. As brutal trials begin, her dangerous connection with its cold leader threatens everything.
descriptions.she-came-out-of-a-coma-after-years: When a pregnant woman’s perfect life shatters after a tragic accident, she wakes up from a coma to find her fiancé now with her jealous sister. Heartbroken and betrayed, she begins to rebuild her world—unaware that the man who’s always loved her in secret is right by her side, ready to help her rise again.
descriptions.shes-his-mission: A brave woman is trapped with a powerful, controlling General and risks everything to escape. She finds an unexpected ally in a tough Marine who has to choose between following orders or helping her fight for their freedom.
descriptions.sins-of-dorian-gray: Dorian, a poor singer, signs a devil’s contract to become a star. But as he gets fame, beauty, and desire, his portrait pays the price for every sin.
descriptions.snow-white-for-basketball-team: She escapes an abusive fiancé and crashes into the world of five irresistible basketball stars — each ready to fight for her heart. But when their strict, cold-hearted coach becomes the one man she can’t stop thinking about, her dangerous ex isn’t the only problem anymore.
descriptions.stolen-by-italian-macho: When a runaway wife escapes her cold marriage and ends up kidnapped by a reckless Sicilian man, chaos turns into passion. Trapped between danger, secrets, and forbidden desire, she must decide whether to flee again — or stay and risk everything for love.
descriptions.stolen-desire: She thought she could rob men and walk away, but Terrence Blake is no easy target—he bought her. Bound to obey him, she must spy on her sisters in the Scarlet Ring, while desire and a deadly plot involving her ex-fiancé close in.
descriptions.swapped-bodies-with-my-secret-crush: When a science experiment and a magic chant force a nerdy girl and a popular jock to swap bodies, their high school lives are thrown into a hilarious, chaotic mess of swim trials, pop quizzes, and first loves. Now, they must navigate each other's worlds and find a way to switch back before they end up falling for each other.
descriptions.taboo-match: When sweet Anna meets her dangerous new stepbrother, sparks fly. But secrets, betrayal, and forbidden love put them both in danger.
descriptions.take-my-breath: A powerful CEO finds herself trapped between a cheating husband, a mafia clan, and a dangerously attractive bodyguard. As secrets unravel and bullets fly, desire becomes her only weakness — and maybe her only way out.
descriptions.take-my-breath-away: When Annabelle marries Prince Henry to save her sister, she must wear a collar that chokes her when she disobeys. Royal family members are dying, and Henry's other wives are missing. Annabelle must find the killer fast before she becomes the next victim.
descriptions.teach-me-after-dark: A shy law student pursues her strict professor in a secret club. When a jealous rival exposes their masked affair and his past scandal, she must defend him in court—only to find he has a shocking secret.
descriptions.teach-me-touch-me: She was top of her class — until her new professor became her biggest lesson. Now caught between lust, lies, and secrets, Brianna must decide: follow her desire or survive it.
descriptions.the-billionaires-pick-perfect-match: A heartbroken billionaire, betrayed by his fiancée, decides to choose his next “bride” in the most unusual way — by her hands. When a poor immigrant girl accidentally falls into his arms, his revenge plan turns into an unexpected romance that neither of them saw coming.
descriptions.the-bodyguard-i-cant-escape: He’s nearly twice her age — all discipline, control, and buried wounds — while she’s a storm still learning where to land. But when danger closes in and the truth about her past cracks open, the man she swore to hate becomes the only one who sees the fire she’s been hiding.
descriptions.the-ceos-blind-spot: In the red-lit world of Velvet Nights, Scarlet becomes a pawn in a dangerous game. Ethan Blake wants the masked girl who haunts him, not knowing she is already standing beside him as his assistant—and hiding a secret that could ruin them both.
descriptions.the-ceos-secret-rules: Desperate to save her sister, Mia takes a contract to be the fake girlfriend of powerful, intense CEO David Blake. Their volatile relationship is complicated by his secret life and a blackmail plot that forces her to choose between her family and the man she loves.
descriptions.the-class-of-lust-and-lies: At Kingston University, poor girl Nora is pulled into a dark world of power and secrets. Her life depends on outsmarting Elliot, the leader of the powerful A.K.B. fraternity. Will she fight back or lose everything?
descriptions.the-club-of-desire: Desperate for cash to pay her family's medical bills and tuition, former lawyer Claire takes a hostess job at the exclusive Club Choulette. Her constant battles with the club’s controlling owner ignite a dangerous attraction neither of them can ignore.
descriptions.the-cold-monster-and-his-brave-prey: A poor girl. A cold politician. A marriage built on lies. As scandals, assassinations, and family secrets explode, Mandy and Lucas must decide if their love can survive the truth.
descriptions.the-cursed-bride-of-the-cold-prince: Locked away as a cursed girl, Cecilia risks everything to force a ruthless prince into a contract marriage. What begins as blackmail slowly turns into a dangerous love neither of them expected.
descriptions.the-deadly-prince: A deadly reality show traps young women in a locked mansion, where the prince must choose only one bride. To win love means survival — but to lose means death.
descriptions.the-diamond-rose: A shy ballet teacher enters a seductive strip club world to save her father — but love, danger, and a powerful crime boss soon turn her life upside down. How far will she go to protect the ones she loves?
descriptions.the-mafia-beast-won-me-in-a-gamble: To pay her father's debt, Mary is forced to marry a scarred mafia boss. In a world of danger and desire, she learns to gamble — with her heart.
descriptions.the-mafias-broken-doll: She made a deal with a mafia boss to save her mother. Now, she’s trapped in his world—his rules, his touch, his obsession.
descriptions.the-mafias-stolen-bride-twin-switch: After her twin steals her life and disappears, Rose is trapped in a mafia nightmare where no one believes who she really is. To survive, she must learn to act like the woman everyone fears—while deciding if she can trust the dangerous man guarding her.
descriptions.the-other-side-of-control: On her wedding day, a confused bride is kidnapped by a tough stranger who says her fiancé lost her to him in a card game. Held at his remote ranch, she must fight for her freedom while learning the shocking and dangerous truth about the man she was going to marry.
descriptions.the-presidents-secret-daughter: After her cold, wealthy husband betrays her, a shy woman disappears and returns as a confident CEO under a new name — ready to take back her life, her power, and make him regret ever losing her.
descriptions.the-queen-stands-again: After her husband steals her victory and breaks her life, Elly loses everything. Rising from the ashes, she teams up with a secret billionaire to destroy those who betrayed her.
descriptions.the-summer-in-between: The rich campers wanted Emily gone by the end of summer. Instead, she became the center of every rumor, every rivalry, and every forbidden desire.
descriptions.the-wolfs-claim: Investigative journalist Lyra is bitten by the Alpha werewolf Pierce Lenegan while trying to expose a corrupt governor. Now Lyra struggles with her transformation and growing attraction to her fated mate. This new, perilous existence is made even more complicated by Pierce's rogue brother who plots with the governor to take him down.
descriptions.thin-ice: After betrayal shatters her career, injured figure skater Emma makes a desperate deal with hot-headed, suspended hockey player James to save both their futures on the ice. But James hides a secret bet that guarantees one of them will fall—and it might not be the one he expects.
descriptions.too-young-to-want-her-professor: After her mother’s death, college freshman Mia tries to continue her legacy as a romance writer—but things spiral when a humiliating classroom moment leads to a unexpected power dynamic with her new professor.
descriptions.trained-to-tempt-broken-by-love: Katrina is a poor girl with a sick brother who gets hit by the car of a powerful escort named Samantha. To pay for her brother's treatment, Katrina joins Samantha’s dangerous world of seduction and secrets — and soon becomes part of a high-stakes mission to manipulate a billionaire.
descriptions.tss-hes-not-my-husband-he-is-my-target: Two secret agents, Chloe and John, must pretend to be a married couple to stop a terrorist deal. But their growing feelings for each other put the whole mission in danger.
descriptions.under-her-protection: When Anna becomes the target of a violent conspiracy, her father hires Jo, a fearless ex-military protector. Jo’s methods are harsh, but they work. As Anna learns to fight back, she also discovers a dangerous attraction to the woman who refuses to let her fall.
descriptions.untouched-scent: A desperate Skyler enters the dark, luxurious world of a billionaire perfume CEO whose strange obsession is her "pure" scent. She signed a contract for her mother's life, but now she realizes the fine print means she belongs to him, body and soul.
descriptions.we-caught-them-together: Two marriages look perfect in public but rot in secret. When Rylee and Wade join forces, love, lies, and manipulation collide in a ruthless revenge plan.
descriptions.what-was-i-made-for: In a mansion ruled by money and power, Eva becomes the unwanted wife of a cruel heir. Her limp makes people underestimate her, but her courage may be the one thing Damian cannot control.
descriptions.who-am-i: An ordinary guy’s boring morning turns into chaos when assassins start shooting at him — and a stranger who looks exactly like him drags him into a deadly chase. Now George must figure out who this double is, and why everyone wants him dead before he loses his identity — and his life.
descriptions.wicked-game: A street thief saves a mafia boss by accident. Now they're both in danger - and the only way to survive is to trust each other. But trust turns into something more... and that could get them both killed.
descriptions.wild-silence: A woman trying to die is saved by a wild, quiet man who keeps her in his remote forest cabin to teach her hard survival rules. As they face the wild and violent hunters, their intense bond is tested by his dark secrets and the choice to accept death or truly start a new life.
descriptions.wrestling-with-love: Cal and Ricky clash in the gym, locker room, school halls, and at home. Their training begins with anger and humiliation, but every match brings them closer to dangerous feelings neither of them knows how to hide.
